title.narrative: Support to ICIMOD 2023-2026 Medium Term Action Plan V

description.narrative:
The support is core- and core programme support to ICIMOD based on their Medium Term Action Plan V for 2023-2026 and the approved strategy for 2023-2030. ICIMOD is an independent regional intergovernmental organization with 8 county members; Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, India, Myanmar, Nepal and Pakistan. The mission of ICIMOD is to build and share knowledge that enables and greener, more inclusive and climate resilient policy,action and investment across the communities in Hindu Kush Himalaya. The four long term impacts are; - Transboundary risk reduction and adaptation; enhanced safety and socioeconomic security - Biodiversity and environmental health; restored landscapes and sustained ecosystem services - Air quality; reduced adverse health impacts while achieving mitigation co-benefits - Green mountain economics: promoted just transition to green and low carbon enterprise
Gender and social and social inclusion (GESI) are embedded in all activities implemented by ICIMOD. Support to collaborative research focusing on the mountain agenda will continue.
